title: 第21章 荒天谷动荡准备截胡主角宝贝第22章 师尊您要是无趣的话这世间还有什么是有趣的
slug: 我反派魔尊开局被清冷师尊强吻
content_zh:
“既然师尊这么说了，那徒儿就好好地为您工作吧！”
“待到明日后，徒儿便将会启程前往荒天谷，去铲除莫名动乱的群妖！”
作为宗门的大师兄，江尘羽也是有任务完成指标的，但是由于江老魔沉迷于修炼，所以上头派下来的指标都是两个徒儿替师完成。
‘已经到这段剧情了？’
听到荒天谷这三个字，江尘羽的眉头挑了挑。
荒天谷群妖动乱的根源是两位返虚境大妖的搏杀。
由于无法忍受对战时候散发的恐怖威压，所以它们才朝着人类所在的领域进发。
至于大妖们为什么会突然出手，那自然是因为龙涎果才打起来。
并且在黄油剧情中，荒天谷最宝贵的宝物还不是龙涎果，而是赤龙陨火。
这种火源自在荒天谷陨落数万年之久的大乘妖龙！
在妖龙陨落后，它的魂魄并没有立刻消散，而是以焰灵的形式苟起来发育。
直到今天，这焰灵才终有所成，结果还没有等它悄悄的跑回妖域呢。
结果就被荒天谷的两位本地大妖给盯上了！
值得一提的是，这段剧情也是萧焱与独孤傲霜相遇的重要剧情。
在这段剧情中。
玩家们能够操纵主角跟独孤傲霜配合下在两位化身大妖的争端中夺走龙涎果，并且还能将赤龙陨火收入囊中，获得第一种宝贵的异火。
‘不过，我都来了，那龙涎果和赤炎陨火自然就是我的了！’
‘要是运气好的话，还能够将萧焱那小子也给一并抹杀。’
江尘羽在默默地思考着，随后瞥了一眼大徒弟。
“我也跟着你去！”

“师尊，您这是何意，难道您怀疑徒儿的实力不足以完成任务？”
独孤傲霜挑了挑秀气的眉头，随后询问道。
‘不过，如果师尊要跟着去也挺好！’
‘跟师尊待在一起时，我就能伺机观察他有没有致命的弱点啥的！’
一想到自己要跟魔头师尊在荒郊野岭度过一晚甚至几晚，大徒弟的眼眸陡然变得明亮了几分。
“不是怀疑，你就是实力不够！”
江尘羽瞥了大徒弟一眼，随后说道。
在原着剧情中，这傻憨憨的大徒弟要是没有主角光环，在两位返虚境大妖那里头都不知道死多少次了！
至于获得龙涎果，并且将修为提升到元婴境，没有光环的加持那更是想都别想。
‘唔～’
听到魔头师尊的那一番话，少女直接攥起了自己的小拳头。
也就是她现在实力还不够，不然铁定会骑在师尊的身上用拳头来疯狂输出，以此来发泄自己内心的郁闷。
“那师尊，我能跟着一起去吗？”
在一旁的李鸾凤显然也是想到了这是能与魔头师尊在外过夜的好机会，于是眼眸她连忙询问道。
“还有我，师尊，诗钰也想跟在师尊身边！”
“如果没有我的话，师尊您要是在外边突然犯病就麻烦了！”
似乎是怕被抛下，不知道什么时候已经悄然穿好衣服的林诗钰小跑着来到了他的身边，还抓住了他的衣角，眼巴巴地看着他。
闻言，江尘羽则是摆了摆手，在二徒弟以及三徒弟的脑袋上一人敲了一下。
他先是瞪了李鸾凤一眼，随后批评道：
“还想着出去，你现在修为才金丹境后期，而你师姐都已经金丹境巅峰甚至隐隐触摸到元婴境的门槛了！”

“都是天才，难道你就差她那么多吗？还不是只知道做任务，不知道修炼导致的！”
content_en:
"Since Master said so, I will work hard for you!"
"After tomorrow, my disciple will set off to Huangtian Valley to eradicate the inexplicable turmoil of the demons!"
As the eldest brother of the sect, Jiang Chenyu also had mission completion targets, but because Jiang Laomo was obsessed with training, the targets assigned by his superiors were all completed by his two disciples.
‘Have we reached this stage of the plot yet? ’
Jiang Chenyu raised his eyebrows when he heard the words Huangtian Valley.
The source of the turmoil among the demons in the Wild Sky Valley is the fight between two great demons in the Return to Void Realm.
Because they couldn't stand the terrifying coercion they exuded during the battle, they headed towards the realm where humans were.
As for why the big demons suddenly took action, it was naturally because of the ambergris fruit.
And in the Butter plot, the most precious treasure in Huangtian Valley is not the ambergris, but the Red Dragon Fire.
This fire originates from the Mahayana demon dragon that has fallen in the Wild Sky Valley for tens of thousands of years!
After the demon dragon died, its soul did not dissipate immediately, but continued to develop in the form of a flame spirit.
It wasn't until today that this flame spirit finally achieved something, but it didn't wait until it quietly ran back to the demon realm.
As a result, he was targeted by two local demons from Huangtian Valley!
It is worth mentioning that this plot is also an important plot for the encounter between Xiao Yan and Dugu Aoshuang.
in this plot.
Players can control the protagonist and Dugu Aoshuang to cooperate with each other to seize the ambergris fruit in the dispute between the two incarnated demons. They can also pocket the Red Dragon Meteor Fire and obtain the first precious exotic fire.
‘However, since I’m here, the Ambergris Fruit and Red Flame Fire are naturally mine! ’
‘If you’re lucky, you can also kill that kid Xiao Yan. ’
Jiang Chenyu was thinking silently, then glanced at his eldest disciple.
"I'll go with you too!"
"Master, what do you mean by this? Do you doubt that my disciple is not strong enough to complete the task?"
Dugu Aoshuang raised a delicate brow and then asked.
'However, it would be great if Master wants to go along! ’
‘When I stay with Master, I can wait and see if he has any fatal weaknesses or anything like that! ’
The eldest disciple's eyes suddenly became a little brighter at the thought of spending a night or even several nights with the demon master in the wilderness.
"It's not doubtful, you just don't have enough strength!"
Jiang Chenyu glanced at his eldest disciple and then said.
In the original plot, if this silly eldest disciple did not have the aura of the protagonist, he would have died countless times in front of the two great demons in the Void Return Realm!
As for obtaining the ambergris fruit and raising your cultivation level to the Nascent Soul realm, it is even more unthinkable without the blessing of the halo.
‘Hmm~’
After hearing what the Demon Master said, the girl directly clenched her little fists.
That is to say, she is not strong enough now, otherwise she will definitely ride on the master's body and use her fists to do crazy damage to vent her inner depression.
"Master, can I go with you?"
Li Luanfeng, who was on the side, obviously thought that this would be a good opportunity to spend the night with the Demon Master, so she asked quickly.
"And I, Master, Shiyu also want to be with Master!"
"Without me, Master, you would be in trouble if you suddenly fell ill outside!"
As if she was afraid of being left behind, Lin Shiyu, who had quietly put on her clothes at some point, jogged to his side, grabbed the corner of his clothes, and looked at him eagerly.
Hearing this, Jiang Chenyu waved his hand and knocked the second and third apprentices on the head.
He first glared at Li Luanfeng, and then criticized:
"You are still thinking about going out. You are only at the late stage of the Golden Core Realm, and your senior sister is already at the peak of the Golden Core Realm and has even faintly touched the threshold of the Nascent Soul Realm!"
"They are all geniuses. Are you that far behind her? Isn't it because you only know how to do tasks and don't know how to practice!"
